name: Marianne
source:
Role: Village Girl
Likes: Flowers, Running Errands
Dislikes: Horror Stories
Alliance: Bastion

This timid maiden lives in a remote Bastion village, far from the frontlines. Her kind, unassuming personality endears her to villagers and animals alike. Yet, her elegant clothes and refined speech suggest a noble upbringing. In that case, why is Marianne residing in this quaint but poor village?

[From the [url=https://www.blissfulberyl.com/empyrealdawn]official website[/url]]
